title: AP management TX (WAL cfg-event cmd 0x01F2) + D2H mgmt RX (HCC group1 id13) - design only, NOT FIRED by this lane
preconditions: base image: FINAL all-patch module (stability 008aca5, 47 params) + patches/0001-mgmt-tx-rx.patch = 49 params
fresh golden boot: page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, state 1, mask 0, staging 0
attended session with the recovery door READY (tools/recovery-card.sh); human at the bench
one module load per boot; UART read-only; recovery physical
test client: one dedicated station, MAC recorded, on a test SSID only
M2 needs an external on-air observer (second radio/phone); our own RX is not proof of TX

module_params.common: proven final-integration recipe: allow_frames=32 frame_gap_ms=100 h2d_send_budget=10 vap_start_first=1 vap_start_mode=1 vap_start_module=0 hcc_poll_ms=5 hcc_trace=0 stop_ap_mode=0 mgmt_diag=0 rx_enable=1 beacon_static=1 beacon_vap_start=1 wpa_keys=1 wpa_key_module=0 sta_join=0 ht_mode=0 vht_cap=0 band_vendor=0 scan_band_cfg=0
module_params.m3: same as M2 + client association (expected add_station blocker); WPA2 only after station ops land

rungs.name: control - compiled-default path is byte-inert
rungs.purpose: prove mgmt_tx=0/mgmt_rx=0 changes no host or device behaviour
steps: fire the proven AP start (beacon_static=1) until hostapd AP-ENABLED
let the test client attempt authentication
capture dmesg, cfg80211_status, page/mask before and after
pass: dmesg: 'hi5622: mgmt_tx op reached - mgmt_tx=0 fail-closed'
dmesg: no "frame post 'mgmt_tx'" line, no 'mgmt RX delivered' line
page 0x86807FEF golden, state 1, mask 0, staging 0, no exception
fail_if: any H2D frame posted by the mgmt path
any DMA-buffer allocation (dmesg 'mgmt_tx: DMA frame buffer')

rungs.name: RX decode - D2H group1 id13 on a live management frame
rungs.purpose: prove the 60-byte-prefix/48-byte-RX-info layout on hardware and the cfg80211 delivery
steps: test client sends a probe/auth request
capture dmesg and the client/hostapd logs
pass: dmesg: 'cfg80211: mgmt RX delivered (subtype 0x0? ch 6 2437 MHz rssi -?? len ??)' for the client frame
hostapd starts its AP-side management handling; its reply fails with -EOPNOTSUPP (mgmt_tx=0, expected)
page/mask clean, no exception, H2D lane open
fail_if: no id13 event decoded when the client transmits
wrong channel/frequency, wrong frame length, malformed counter increments
any device write from the RX path

rungs.name: TX carrier - WAL cfg-event cmd 0x01F2 (the lane's central [U])
rungs.purpose: decide whether the PD4 firmware WAL group-2 dispatch accepts the vendor mgmt-tx command and DMA-reads the frame
steps: test client authenticates; hostapd replies to the auth request through .mgmt_tx
watch dmesg for the frame-post line; watch the external observer for the auth response on air
pass: host: "frame post 'mgmt_tx': g2 id0 total 44 B in SR0 slot ... devva 0x8....... coalesced announce consumed after N polls"
air (external observer): authentication response visible with the VAP BSSID (or the client reports authenticated)
page/mask clean, no exception, no out[0] timeout
outcomes: refused by the fail-closed gates (no device write) -> adjust allow_frames budget/gate; carrier still untested

announce consumed but no frame on air -> firmware accepted the WAL event but did not fetch the frame at the descriptor address (host-VA/devVA convention missing on this firmware); record, then use the data-TXQ fallback design
consumed + auth rsp on air -> the host-SME mgmt path works
fail_if: coalesced announce not consumed (H2D lane closed; never retry)

rungs.name: association + WPA2 (expected blocker measurement, cross-lane)
rungs.purpose: measure how far host-SME association gets; station ops and EAPOL are later lanes
steps: continue from M2: client sends the association request
expect the RX delivery line for the assoc request, then hostapd 'Could not add STA to kernel driver' (no .add_station op)
only after station ops land: WPA2 fixture from wifi-wpa-static, watch the 4-way handshake (needs EAPOL data delivery to the netdev)
pass: assoc request decoded and delivered (RX line)
the failure point is exactly the documented missing station op
fail_if: assoc request not decoded (points back at M1)
any attempt to fake association or install a PTK without the firmware STA context

stop_rules: firmware exception / golden page lost / state != 1 / mask != 0 / staging != 0 -> record dmesg + counters, power-cycle, analyse offline
frame post timeout or out[0] not consumed -> H2D lane closed; never retry; record and power-cycle
never re-post a frame in the same boot; never write CA 0x400392F0; never read CA window 0x10161000; never post mailbox id 5; never send HCC groups 1/4 H2D; never rmmod the vendor modules
a client that produced an exception stays disconnected for the rest of the boot
evidence_to_capture: dmesg (full boot + rung), cfg80211_status, modinfo -p, page/mask before/after
external observer capture of the auth/assoc response (M2/PASS) with BSSID + channel
client MAC and its management-frame log
